Control options for private modified winsorized scree estimation

Source: R/scree.R
pmwm_control.Rd

Creates a control list for method = "pmwm" in dp_scree() or the scree configuration of dp_pca().

Usage

pmwm_control(a, b, trim_const, eta, beta = 1.001, split_mode = FALSE)

Arguments

a, b

Required finite public bounds for private quantile cutoffs, with a < b, on the scale of squared pair differences.

trim_const

Required positive public trimming constant.

eta

Required public tuning value in [0, 0.5).

beta

Geometric quantile-search base greater than 1 (1.001 by default).

split_mode

Whether to split score pairs between quantile and mean estimation (FALSE by default).

Value

A control list for method = "pmwm".

Details

PMWM estimates lower and upper private quantiles of squared pair differences, truncates the cutoffs to [a, b], winsorizes the data, and perturbs the mean vector. The cutoffs, not the original data, are bounded. If the estimated upper cutoff is smaller than the lower, the cutoffs are reset to a and b.

With k components, each of 2k private quantiles receives epsilon / (4k); Gaussian mean estimation receives the remaining half of epsilon and all delta. If n_q is the number of paired rows used for quantile estimation, the trimming proportion is $$p=\min\{\max(\mathrm{trim\_const}/n_q,\eta),0.49\}.$$ With split_mode = TRUE, the pair rows are split between quantile and mean estimation (at least four observations are required); otherwise all rows are reused under the same privacy allocation. Tunings must be public or selected through an accounted private procedure.

References

Ramsay K, Spicker D (2025). “Improved subsample-and-aggregate via the private modified winsorized mean.” Code available at https://github.com/12ramsake/PMWM, 2501.14095, https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.14095.

Durfee D (2023). “Unbounded Differentially Private Quantile and Maximum Estimation.” In Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, volume 36, 77691–77712. doi:10.52202/075280-3394 , https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper_files/paper/2023/hash/f4b6ef2a78684dca2fb3f1c09372e041-Abstract-Conference.html.

See also

dp_scree() for computing differentially private scree estimates using these control options. plot.dp_scree() for plotting scree estimates.

Examples

pmwm_control(a = 0, b = 20, trim_const = 10, eta = 0.01)
#> $beta
#> [1] 1.001
#> 
#> $a
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $b
#> [1] 20
#> 
#> $trim_const
#> [1] 10
#> 
#> $eta
#> [1] 0.01
#> 
#> $split_mode
#> [1] FALSE
#>
